verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a first-party, user-configurable automation feature, such as a workflow or rule builder that runs autonomously in the background. Webhooks that can 'trigger an additional action' are a developer building block for constructing automations, and automated tax filing is a narrow built-in feature rather than user-set-up automations, so neither earns credit. Agent and MCP docs cover buyer-facing agents, not background store automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
